mutants.label: check drops the deps-file-exists conjunct
mutants.why: Killed by test_skips_an_active_skill_with_no_deps_file: an active rostered skill with no deps file must be skipped, not crash reading a missing deps file.

mutants.label: check evaluates an inactive skill too
mutants.why: Killed by test_does_not_evaluate_an_inactive_skills_direct_tier_change: an inactive rostered skill must never be evaluated by this guard, regardless of what its direct tier's diff contains.

mutants.label: [does-nothing] check drops the tier-touched conjunct
mutants.why: Killed by test_no_fail_when_the_diff_never_touches_the_direct_tier and test_no_fail_on_an_empty_diff: the positive conjunct (the diff must actually touch the direct tier) must hold, or an unrelated change — including no change at all — spuriously fails an active skill.

mutants.label: check drops the base-ref half of the tier-files union, missing a deletion
F1: _changed_paths drops --no-renames, a rename out of the tier escapes
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_a_direct_tier_file_is_renamed_out_of_the_tier: with rename detection on, `git diff --name-only` prints only the new path, so a tier file renamed out never appears in `changed` under its old (tier-member) path, and the guard fails open.

mutants.label: _added_paths drops the 'A' status filter, counting modified files as added
mutants.why: Killed by test_a_modified_preexisting_run_file_does_not_satisfy_the_requirement: only a run file the diff genuinely adds can satisfy the requirement, never one that merely changed.

mutants.label: F2/I5: _has_matching_green_run drops the runs-directory depth and skill-scoping filter
mutants.why: Killed by test_a_nested_raw_json_under_runs_does_not_satisfy_the_requirement (a nested attempt raw would satisfy the guard) and test_a_run_file_under_a_different_skills_runs_dir_does_not_satisfy_the_requirement (another skill's run file would satisfy it too) once this conjunct is gone.

mutants.label: I5: _has_matching_green_run loosens the runs-directory check to any skill's runs dir
mutants.why: Killed by test_a_run_file_under_a_different_skills_runs_dir_does_not_satisfy_the_requirement: a run file only counts for skill S if it is under evals/S/runs/, never another rostered skill's runs dir. This mutant keeps the depth requirement (still blocks a nested raw) but drops the skill-name segment, so it isolates the cross-skill claim from F2's depth claim above.

mutants.label: _has_matching_green_run drops the direct-tier-hash comparison
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_a_green_run_files_hash_does_not_match: a green run file added by the diff must still carry the exact current direct-tier hash, not merely exist.

mutants.label: I4: _has_matching_green_run loosens the hash comparison to a substring check
mutants.why: Killed by test_a_green_run_file_with_a_missing_direct_tier_hash_does_not_satisfy_the_requirement and test_a_green_run_file_with_an_empty_direct_tier_hash_does_not_satisfy_the_requirement: an empty string is a substring of every string, so a missing or empty recorded hash would satisfy the guard under `in` instead of `==`.
mutants.replace:
if str(run.get("fingerprint", {}).get("direct_tier_hash", "")) in expected_hash:
            return True

mutants.label: I1: _changed_paths uses a two-dot range, leaking base-only history
mutants.why: Killed by test_ignores_base_only_changes_via_three_dot_range: the guard must diff $(VERSION_BASE)...HEAD (merge-base relative), or a commit the base branch makes to the tier AFTER the PR forked spuriously fails a PR that never touches it.

mutants.label: N2/I11: _has_matching_green_run drops the .json-suffix requirement
mutants.why: Killed by test_a_non_json_run_file_does_not_satisfy_the_requirement: only a file directly in evals/<skill>/runs/ with a .json suffix is ever a run file the ledger writes; a .txt file with otherwise-valid green content and the current hash must never satisfy the guard.
